sloka: सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहः ।इति बुद्धिं समास्थाय जलात्कूलमुपागमत् ।। ७.८८.१५ ॥
transliteration: sadṛśīyaṁ mama bhavedyadi nānyaparigrahaḥ ।iti buddhiṁ samāsthāya jalātkūlamupāgamat ।। 7.88.15 ॥

translations.english: Having firmly resolved that she would be suitable for him if she were not already taken by another, he then went from the water to the bank.
